summary.intent: Run Phase 39 execution in an isolated worktree while simultaneously running simplify (code quality) agents against the Phase 38 branch, then apply the actionable findings.
summary.outcome: Both Phase 39 executor agents hit usage limits before completing; the FolderNode construction deduplication fix was applied to useFolderNavigation.ts on docs/phase-38-context and committed. Wave 1 Plans 01+02 of Phase 39 were committed by an earlier executor on docs/phase-39-context before the limit was hit.

repo: Phase 39 development uses docs/phase-39-context branch; Phase 38 uses docs/phase-38-context branch.
getSdkClient() returns a cached singleton and .getContext() returns a plain field (this.ctx) — 11 calls across hooks are verbose but not a real performance concern.
uint8ToBase64 duplication spans sdk-core/src/file/index.ts and file-metadata.service.ts, but the latter is being deleted in Phase 38, making deduplication non-actionable in this phase.
The flat-params pattern in sdk-core functions (no store dependency) is intentional and established in useSharedWriteOps.ts — not parameter sprawl.
purgeExpired fire-and-forget is intentional pre-existing pattern; withConflictRetry callbacks intentionally re-read fresh state on each iteration.

code.finding: Two FolderNode construction branches share 7 fields — deduplication fix was applied here during the simplify pass.

workflow: Executor agents for a new phase should always run in an isolated worktree (isolation: 'worktree') to avoid branch conflicts with main-thread work.
Simplify agents must be explicitly targeted to the correct branch — they defaulted to the wrong branch (docs/phase-39-context) until manually corrected.
git checkout/stash failures can be silent; always verify current branch after a branch switch attempt.
Background agents hitting usage limits mid-task requires manual continuation — check worktree git state and main branch commits to determine the furthest progress point before resuming.

friction: Phase 39 executor initially ran on the wrong branch (docs/phase-39-context in the main worktree) instead of an isolated worktree, causing branch conflicts.
Stash+checkout sequence failed silently, leaving the assistant on docs/phase-39-context while believing it had switched to docs/phase-38-context.
Both Phase 39 background executor agents hit Claude usage limits before completing, requiring manual continuation.
Simplify agents were launched against the wrong branch initially, wasting a round-trip.
The simplify agent flagged getSdkClient().getContext() caching as HIGH priority, but investigation revealed it was a non-issue — overstated severity required manual verification.
